workflow.name: write-zenonzard-cards

nodes.name: Repair review findings
nodes.prompt_template: Repair only the concrete review findings in the current workspace, then rerun every affected semantic scenario and project check. Return all_passed with concise repair_evidence. Preserve already accepted card work.

nodes.name: Verify repaired review findings
nodes.prompt_template: Independently verify the repaired review findings and the final workspace against the card authoring contract and fresh check evidence. Return concrete findings and all_passed; all_passed is true only when every prior finding is resolved and all requirements remain satisfied.

nodes.name: Repair second review findings
nodes.prompt_template: Repair only the concrete review findings in the current workspace, then rerun every affected semantic scenario and project check. Return all_passed with concise repair_evidence. Preserve already accepted card work.

nodes.name: Verify second review repair
nodes.prompt_template: Independently verify the repaired review findings and the final workspace against the card authoring contract and fresh check evidence. Return concrete findings and all_passed; all_passed is true only when every prior finding is resolved and all requirements remain satisfied.

nodes.name: Repair third review findings
nodes.prompt_template: Repair only the concrete review findings in the current workspace, then rerun every affected semantic scenario and project check. Return all_passed with concise repair_evidence. Preserve already accepted card work.

nodes.name: Verify third review repair
nodes.prompt_template: Independently verify the repaired review findings and the final workspace against the card authoring contract and fresh check evidence. Return concrete findings and all_passed; all_passed is true only when every prior finding is resolved and all requirements remain satisfied.

nodes.name: Final review
nodes.prompt_template: Assess metadata_check and the latest applicable successful review (repaired_review_3, repaired_review_2, repaired_review_1, then initial_review). State whether the task is complete and explain any unresolved findings using your own concise assessment.

nodes.name: Implement ten-card batches
nodes.prompt_template: Inspect the shared runtime once for the supplied card batch, then implement every card module and its positive and boundary scenarios directly in the Host-assigned paths. Reuse existing APIs and put any required shared-runtime change in shared_change_request for the downstream integration owner. Return concise changes and shared_change_request for each card.

nodes.name: Integrate shared runtime once
nodes.prompt_template: Apply the shared runtime changes requested by the card workers, run focused checks, and return all_passed with concise integration_evidence.

nodes.name: Validate scenario batches
nodes.prompt_template: Inspect the assigned validation batch, its card jobs, scenario records, modules and evidence. Check Japanese rule meaning and English cross-check, required and optional choices, target minima, zones, Force conditions, capacity replacement, controller-only views and exact public reveals. Assess whether positive and boundary scenarios test those behaviors through GameSession.choose; passing executions alone do not establish semantic coverage. Return one ordered item_validations entry per card job with passed and concise semantic evidence. Set all_passed exactly when every item passed.

nodes.name: Repair failed cards
nodes.prompt_template: Repair every supplied failed card in the Host-assigned paths and run its supplied positive and boundary scenarios. Complete card-local work in those paths. When a repair also needs shared runtime work, describe that work in shared_change_request for the downstream shared-write owner. Return only concise evidence and shared_change_request for each repair in input order; the Host retains accepted entries and redispatches only unresolved entries.

nodes.name: Integrate repair shared runtime once
nodes.prompt_template: Apply the requested shared runtime changes once across the repaired cards. Reuse the existing Engine, effect and GameSession interfaces, run focused checks for every shared change, and return all_passed with concise integration_evidence.

nodes.name: Run checks
nodes.prompt_template: Run the required aggregate checks against the current workspace: affected pack tests, tests/test_game_session_choice_validation.py, python compileall for zz/tests/tools, node syntax validation for zz/web/static/app.js, and printed metadata parity. Use the prepared manifest, repair evidence and shared-integration evidence. Return all_passed and compact check_evidence containing the commands, failures and fresh outcomes. all_passed must be false when generation integration, repair integration or any required check fails.

nodes.name: Review changes
nodes.prompt_template: Review changed artifacts and current verification evidence against the card authoring contract. Confirm source reconciliation, reuse of shared paths, real names/assets, rule semantics, private/public visibility and meaningful positive/boundary coverage. Check repairs and fresh reruns resolve initial validation findings, including shared runtime work, and metadata parity covers every requested card. Return concrete findings and all_passed. Set all_passed=false when generation integration, repair integration, semantic validation or aggregate checks failed, evidence is missing, or an applicable requirement is unmet.
